name: M. M. Coleman
bio: M. M. "Mike" Coleman was a partner in Coleman & Brown, proprietors of the Medora hotel, until the firm dissolved in September 1884, after which he kept improving and painting his hotel. In August 1884 he took a bunch of the company's cattle to Duluth. In November 1884 he and Riley circulated the petition and raised the money that opened Medora's school, and he and his wife celebrated their 18th wedding anniversary in February 1885. He received votes in the Billings County election of April 1886.
